```{r}
cell_line = list("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62")
sample_type_palette = c("Cell-line"="#b5e2fa", "Xenograft" = "#ffd6a5")
hrd_palette= c("HRD" ="#CC79A7" , "HRR" = "#009E73")
hrd_sample_list <- list("134011_1910_T4", "134062_9174_T4", "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3", "WEHI_CS62", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30")
methylation_palette = c("Me" = "red", "Un" = "blue")
```

```{r}
pdx11 <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/QC/*_summary.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = "mean_qscore_template") %>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_summary.tsv", "", basename(.x)))) 

nanopore_len <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/QC/*_summary.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = "sequence_length_template") %>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_summary.tsv", "", basename(.x)))) 


# subset for testing 
pdx11_sub <- pdx11 %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  sample_n(1000) %>%
  ungroup()

qscore_sub <- pdx11_sub %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = mean_qscore_template, sample, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
       strip.text.x = element_blank())+
  ylab("Mean Base Quality Score")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)


# subset for testing 
library(ggridges)
nanopore_len_sub <- nanopore_len%>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  sample_n(1000) %>%
  ungroup()



# actual plotting 
len_plot <- nanopore_len %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sequence_length_template, y = sample, fill = sample_type))+
  stat_density_ridges(stat = "density")+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_y", strip.position = "right", nrow = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none",
       strip.text.y = element_blank())+
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)+
  xlab("Read Length (bp)")



qscore <- pdx11 %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = mean_qscore_template, sample, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none")+
  ylab("Mean Base Quality Score")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)
  

```
# QC plots 
```{r}
coverage <- Sys.glob("output/*/coverage/*mosdepth.summary.txt")%>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x)%>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_unphased.mosdepth.summary.txt", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, level = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))


coverage_plot <-coverage %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(coverage = round(sum(mean *bases / sum(bases)), 0)) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = coverage, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme_bw()+
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(coverage, "x")), vjust=0)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none",
       axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  ylab("Averaged Depth")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette, "Sample")
  

merged_plot <- ggarrange(len_plot,ggarrange(coverage_plot+
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.title.x = element_blank()), qscore, nrow = 2, heights = c(0.3, 0.7), align= "v"), common.legend = T, legend = "bottom")
ggsave(plot = merged_plot, filename = "plots/nanopore_qc.pdf",  width = 210, height = 297, units = "mm")
```

# brca1 plotting  -+-500bps
```{r}
brca1 <- Sys.glob("output/*/Me/*_brca1_mod.summary")%>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.) %>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_brca1_mod.summary", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  filter(mod_code == "m") 


PLOTLIST <- brca1 %>%
  mutate(Meth = if_else(mod_qual >0.5, "Me", "Un"),
         HRD = if_else(sample %in% hrd_sample_list, "HRD", "HRR"),
         HRD = factor(HRD, levels = c("HRR", "HRD"))) %>%
  # filter(ref_position >=43125336, ref_position <= 43170245,
  #        base_qual >20, !inferred) %>%
    filter(ref_position >=43125336-200, ref_position <= 43125457+200,
         base_qual >20, !inferred) %>%
  group_by(ref_position, sample, HRD) %>%
  filter(n()>=3) %>%
  summarise(
    number = n(),
    Me_percent = sum(Meth =="Me")/ n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(HRD) %>%
  group_map(~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = ref_position,y = Me_percent, color = HRD))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point(size = 0.5)+
  facet_wrap(~sample, nrow = 8, dir = "v")+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
 annotate("rect",xmin=43125336,xmax=43125457,ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf,alpha=0.1,fill="black")+
  # annotate("rect", xmin = 43126118, xmax= 43126443, ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf,alpha=0.1,fill="yellow")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "Methylation (%)")+
  scale_color_manual(values =hrd_palette, drop =F, "HR Status"), .keep = T)

library(patchwork)
layout <-"
AB
AB
AB
AB
AB
A#
A#
A#
"
PLOTLIST[[1]]+PLOTLIST[[2]]+ plot_layout(design = layout, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom')

ggsave("plots/200bp_amplicon.pdf",  width = 210, height = 297, units = "mm" )



library(ggbeeswarm)
brca1 %>%
  mutate(Meth = if_else(mod_qual >0.5, "Me", "Un"),
         HRD = if_else(sample %in% hrd_sample_list, "HRD", "HRR"),
         HRD = factor(HRD, levels = c("HRR", "HRD"))) %>%
  # filter(ref_position >=43125336, ref_position <= 43170245,
  #        base_qual >20, !inferred) %>%
    filter(ref_position >=43126118, ref_position <= 43126443,
         base_qual >20, !inferred) %>%
  group_by(ref_position, sample, HRD) %>%
    group_by(ref_position, sample, HRD) %>%
  filter(n()>=3) %>%
  summarise(
    number = n(),
    Me_percent = sum(Meth =="Me")/ n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = Me_percent, color = HRD))+
  geom_violin()+
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 0.5, size = 0.5)+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1)+
  scale_color_manual(values =hrd_palette, drop =F, "HR Status")+
  facet_wrap(~HRD, scales = "free_x")+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "Methylation (%)")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank())
  ggsave("plots/closest_island.pdf", height = 5, width = 8)
```

# brca1 plotting individual reads
```{r}
brca1_reads <- brca1 %>%
  mutate(Meth = if_else(mod_qual >0.5, "Me", "Un"),
         HRD = if_else(sample %in% hrd_sample_list, "HRD", "HRR"),
         HRD = factor(HRD, levels = c("HRR", "HRD"))) %>%
  # filter(ref_position >=43125336, ref_position <= 43170245,
  #        base_qual >20, !inferred) %>%
    filter(ref_position >=43125336-200, ref_position <= 43125457+200,
         base_qual >20, !inferred) %>%
  group_by(read_id) %>%
  filter(sum(ref_position <= 43125457 & ref_position >=43125336)>2 ) %>%
  mutate(meth_count = sum(Meth == "Me")) %>%
  ungroup() 


plot_list <-brca1_reads%>%
  mutate(read_id = factor(read_id, levels = unique(brca1_reads$read_id[order(brca1_reads$ref_mod_strand, brca1_reads$meth_count)])),
         Meth = factor(Meth, levels = c("Me", "Un"))) %>%
  group_by(HRD, sample) %>%
  group_map(~ggplot(.x, aes(y= read_id, x = ref_position, color = Meth))+
  annotate("rect",xmin=43125336,xmax=43125457,ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf,alpha=0.1,fill="black")+
  geom_point(size = 0.3)+
  facet_wrap(~ref_mod_strand, scales = "free_y", nrow =2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = methylation_palette, drop = F, "Methylation")+
    theme_bw()+
  labs(title = unique(.x$sample))+
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(colour=hrd_palette[unique(.x$HRD)],  face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()), .keep = T)


layout <-"
AI
BJ
CK
DL
EM
F#
G#
H#
"

plot_list[[1]]+plot_list[[2]]+plot_list[[3]]+plot_list[[4]]+
  plot_list[[5]]+plot_list[[6]]+plot_list[[7]]+plot_list[[8]]+
  plot_list[[9]]+ plot_list[[10]]+ plot_list[[11]]+plot_list[[12]]+
  plot_list[[13]]+
  plot_layout(design = layout, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom')

ggsave("plots/reads_resolution.pdf",  width = 210, height = 297, units = "mm" )
```

```{r}
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(Gviz)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)

txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene
txTr <-GeneRegionTrack(txdb, chromosome = "chr17", start = 43125336-500, end = 43125457+500)
gene(txTr) <- select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = gene(txTr), keytpe = "ENTREZID", columns= "SYMBOL") %>%
  pull(SYMBOL)

plotTracks(txTr, transcriptAnnotation = "transcript")
```
